Q1: Portland cement exhibits known Tier 1 dermal and eye hazards. It also has expanded perspective (Tier 2) hazards for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity, environmental impacts, endocrine disruption, and inhalation. Oral and organ/systemic hazards are currently data deficient (Tier 4).
Q2: Portland cement is identified on the TEDX list of Potential Endocrine Disruptors, indicating a potential concern regarding its impact on the endocrine system. It is not currently listed on any "low hazard" lists.
Q3: Portland cement appears poorly characterized. With zero scientific literature references in SciFinder (compared to a median of 963 in the dataset), an "Unspecified" molecular formula, and classified as "Manual Registration" and "Registered Concept," its fundamental definition is incomplete. This lack of characterization is further reflected by two hazard classes (oral and organ/systemic) being data deficient.
